SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("t".numtsttakr, 0)), 2) AS "average_sat_test_takers" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "t" ON "t".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Los Angeles' AND "s".opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND "s".opendate < DATE '2008-01-01' AND "s".doctype IN ('County Office of Education (COE)', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".fundingtype, COUNT(*) AS "school_count", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)")::NUMERIC * 100, 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", ROUND(AVG("sa".avgscrread + "sa".avgscrmath + "sa".avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_combined_sat_score" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sa" ON "sa".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sa".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".charter = 1 AND "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "s".fundingtype ORDER BY "s".fundingtype ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "frpm" AS "f" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "s" ON "s".cdscode = "f".cdscode WHERE "s".school IS NOT NULL AND "s".school <> '' AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."High Grade" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "satscores" AS "sat" WHERE "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".numtsttakr > 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".district, "s".county, "sat".avgscrwrite FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "sat".avgscrwrite = (SELECT MAX("sat2".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat2" ON "sat2".cds = "s2".cdscode WHERE "s2".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat2".rtype = 'S' AND "sat2".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL AND "sat2".avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX("sat3".avgscrwrite) FROM "schools" AS "s3" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat3" ON "sat3".cds = "s3".cdscode WHERE "s3".statustype = 'Closed' AND "sat3".rtype = 'S' AND "sat3".avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "schools" AS "s" WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".eilname = 'High School' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "satscores" AS "sat" WHERE "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".numtsttakr > 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."County Name" AS "county_name", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_schools", ROUND(AVG(ROUND("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0), 2)), 2) AS "average_free_meal_percentage", ROUND(AVG(ROUND("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0), 2)), 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1) AS "number_of_charter_schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0) AS "number_of_non_charter_schools", ROUND(AVG("s".avgscrread::NUMERIC + "s".avgscrmath + "s".avgscrwrite), 2) AS "average_sat_score" FROM "frpm" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode AND "s".rtype = 'S' WHERE "f"."County Code" = (SELECT "County Code" FROM "frpm" WHERE cdscode = '01612590125716') AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700 GROUP BY "f"."County Name" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) || '/12' AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" WHERE county = 'San Diego' AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' AND school IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".virtual IN ('F', 'P')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrmath > 400 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school, "s".county, "s".district, "s".city, "f"."Enrollment (K-12)", "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)", "f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", "sat".numtsttakr, "sat".avgscrread, "sat".avgscrmath, "sat".avgscrwrite, "sat".numge1500 FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".cdscode = '01612590137943' LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".school, ROUND("q".rate, 4) AS "free meal rate", CASE "q".charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter school", "q".gsserved AS "grades served", CASE WHEN "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "SAT performance level" FROM (SELECT "s".school, "s".cdscode, "s".charter, "s".gsserved, "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC AS "rate", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND ("s".gsserved = '12' OR "s".gsserved LIKE '%-12') AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL) AS "q" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "q".cdscode WHERE "q".ranking = 1 ORDER BY "q".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "name", "s".phone, "s".website, "sat".avgscrread AS "average_sat_reading", "sat".avgscrmath AS "average_sat_math", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "average_sat_writing", "s".charter = 1 AS "is_charter_school", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "k12_enrollment", ROUND(("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "frpm_eligible_percentage", (SELECT MAX("a".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "a" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "active_school" ON "active_school".cdscode = "a".cds WHERE "active_school".statustype = 'Active' AND "a".rtype = 'S' AND "a".numtsttakr >= 10) AS "highest_average_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("a".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "a" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "active_school" ON "active_school".cdscode = "a".cds WHERE "active_school".statustype = 'Active' AND "a".rtype = 'S' AND "a".numtsttakr >= 10) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "math_score_below_highest" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".county, "ranked".school_count, COALESCE("best".school, 'None') AS "school_name" FROM (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "school_count", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "county_rank" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county) AS "ranked" LEFT JOIN (SELECT county, school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avgscrread DESC) AS "score_rank" FROM (SELECT "s".county, "s".school, MAX("t".avgscrread) AS "avgscrread" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "t" ON "t".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".virtual = 'F' AND "t".avgscrread IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s".cdscode, "s".county, "s".school) AS "scores") AS "best" ON "best".county = "ranked".county AND "best".score_rank = 1 WHERE "ranked".school_count >= (SELECT MIN("fifth".school_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5) AS "fifth") ORDER BY "ranked".school_count DESC, "ranked".county ASC, "best".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS "printings" FROM "foreign_data" WHERE language IN ('Chinese Simplified', 'Chinese Traditional', 'French', 'German', 'Italian', 'Japanese', 'Korean', 'Portuguese (Brazil)', 'Russian', 'Spanish') GROUP BY language HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(language_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "language_count" FROM "foreign_data" WHERE language IN ('Chinese Simplified', 'Chinese Traditional', 'French', 'German', 'Italian', 'Japanese', 'Korean', 'Portuguese (Brazil)', 'Russian', 'Spanish') GROUP BY language) AS "counts") ORDER BY language ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".id) AS "count" FROM "cards" AS "c" INNER JOIN "sets" AS "s" ON "s".code = "c".setcode INNER JOIN "foreign_data" AS "f" ON "f".uuid = "c".uuid WHERE "s".name = 'Coldsnap' AND "f".language = 'Italian' AND TRIM("f".text) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".id, "s".name, COUNT(DISTINCT "st".language) FILTER (WHERE "st".translation IS NOT NULL) AS "official_languages" FROM "sets" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "set_translations" AS "st" ON "st".setcode = "s".code WHERE "s".type = 'commander' AND "s".releasedate >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND "s".releasedate < DATE '2021-01-01' AND "s".totalsetsize = (SELECT MAX("s2".totalsetsize) FROM "sets" AS "s2" WHERE "s2".type = 'commander' AND "s2".releasedate >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND "s2".releasedate < DATE '2021-01-01') GROUP BY "s".id, "s".name ORDER BY "s".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "f".language) AS "foreign_language_count" FROM "cards" AS "c" INNER JOIN "foreign_data" AS "f" ON "f".uuid = "c".uuid WHERE "c".name = 'Swamp' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".name) AS "card_count" FROM "cards" AS "c" INNER JOIN "foreign_data" AS "f" ON "f".uuid = "c".uuid WHERE "c".colors = 'B' AND (',' || "c".types || ',') LIKE '%,Artifact,%' AND "f".flavortext IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("f".flavortext) <> '' LIMIT 501
SELECT "u".displayname FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "p".title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ph".userid AS "user_id" FROM "posthistory" AS "ph" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "ph".postid WHERE "p".viewcount >= 1000 AND "ph".userid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "ph".userid, "ph".postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date >= '2010-01-01' AND date < '2011-01-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date >= '2011-01-01' AND date < '2012-01-01')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "difference_percentage_points" FROM "badges" WHERE name = 'Student' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".displayname = 'Community' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id AS "post_id", "u".displayname AS "owner_display_name" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".favoritecount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".favoritecount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "p".viewcount, "u".displayname FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "p".lasteditoruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".title = 'Computer game datasets' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".text, "u".displayname FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".postid LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "c".userid WHERE "p".title = 'Analysing wind data with R' ORDER BY "c".creationdate DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".score > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".owneruserid = (SELECT "u".id FROM "users" AS "u" ORDER BY "u".reputation DESC NULLS LAST, "u".id ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "comments" AS "c" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".postid INNER JOIN (SELECT postid FROM "comments" GROUP BY postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) AS "single_comment" ON "single_comment".postid = "c".postid WHERE "c".score = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts") AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%United Kingdom%' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".age), 2) AS "average_age" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT userid FROM "comments" WHERE text LIKE '%http://%') AS "c" ON "c".userid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "qualified".userid) AS "user_count" FROM (SELECT "organizer".userid, "organizer".id FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "organizer" ON "organizer".userid = "u".id AND "organizer".name = 'Organizer' INNER JOIN "badges" AS "earlier" ON "earlier".userid = "u".id AND "earlier".date < "organizer".date WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' GROUP BY "organizer".userid, "organizer".id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) AS "qualified" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "user_count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT owneruserid, MIN(creaiondate) AS "first_post_date" FROM "posts" GROUP BY owneruserid) AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".first_post_date >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".first_post_date < '2011-01-01' AND "u".location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])India([^[:alnum:]]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation)) AS "average_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE score < 20 AND tags LIKE '%<r>%') AS "authors" ON "authors".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("p".score) FILTER (WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%'), 0) AS "germany_last_editor_total_score", COALESCE(SUM("p".score) FILTER (WHERE "u".location NOT ILIKE '%Germany%' OR "u".location IS NULL), 0) AS "other_posts_total_score", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "users" AS "gu" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT lasteditoruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01') AS "editors" ON "editors".lasteditoruserid = "gu".id WHERE "gu".location ILIKE '%Germany%') AS "germany_last_editor_user_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("gu".reputation), 0) FROM "users" AS "gu" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT lasteditoruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01') AS "editors" ON "editors".lasteditoruserid = "gu".id WHERE "gu".location ILIKE '%Germany%') AS "germany_last_editor_combined_reputation" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("u".reputation) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE score = 10 AND tags LIKE '%<r>%') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("u".reputation), 0) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE tags LIKE '%<r>%' AND lasactivitydate >= '2014-08-27' AND lasactivitydate < '2014-08-28') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("p".score), 0) AS "total_score" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "l".postid FROM "postlinks" AS "l" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "target" ON "target".id = "l".relatedpostid WHERE "target".posttypeid = 1 AND "target".title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?') AS "links" ON "links".postid = "p".id WHERE "p".posttypeid = 1 AND "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

SELECT displayname, badge_total FROM (SELECT "u".displayname, COUNT("b".id) AS "badge_total", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT("b".id) DESC) AS "badge_rank" FROM "users" AS "u" LEFT JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' GROUP BY "u".id, "u".displayname) AS "ranked" WHERE badge_rank = 2 ORDER BY displayname ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, displayname, views, reputation FROM "users" WHERE (location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])california([^[:alnum:]]|$)' OR location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])CA([^[:alnum:]]|$)') AND location !~* 'south africa' AND views = (SELECT MAX(views) FROM "users" WHERE (location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])california([^[:alnum:]]|$)' OR location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])CA([^[:alnum:]]|$)') AND location !~* 'south africa') LIMIT 501

SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE LOWER(TRIM(location)) IN ('york', 'york, united kingdom') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE LOWER(TRIM(location)) IN ('york', 'york, united kingdom')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".id) AS "user_count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%India%' AND "b".name = 'Yearling' AND "b".date < '2014-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "u".displayname) AS "display_name_count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "b" ON "b".userid = "u".id WHERE "u".age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 AND "b".name = 'Supporter' AND "u".displayname <> 'NaN' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".title, "ranked".related_post_count FROM (SELECT "p".title, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".relatedpostid) AS "related_post_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "l".relatedpostid) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "postlinks" AS "l" ON "l".postid = "p".id WHERE "p".title ILIKE '%principal component scores%' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".title) AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".ranking = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT id FROM "users" WHERE displayname = 'Michael' ORDER BY creationdate DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".owneruserid IS NOT NULL THEN 'id:' || "p".owneruserid::TEXT WHEN "p".ownerdisplayname IS NOT NULL THEN 'name:' || "p".ownerdisplayname END) AS "user_count" FROM "votes" AS "v" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "v".postid WHERE "v".bountyamount >= 30 AND "v".creationdate >= DATE '2010-01-01' AND "v".creationdate < DATE '2011-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".reputation), 2) AS "average_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2011-01-01') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "u".location ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])india([^[:alnum:]]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".upvotes::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_upvotes", ROUND(AVG("u".age::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_age" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS "active" ON "active".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT (DATE_TRUNC('month', "l".creationdate), "p".id))::NUMERIC / 12, 2) AS "average_monthly_posts" FROM "postlinks" AS "l" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".relatedpostid WHERE "l".creationdate >= '2010-01-01' AND "l".creationdate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".answercount <= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "users" AS "u" WHERE "u".id = "p".owneruserid AND "u".reputation >= 1000)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT editor, edit_comments FROM (SELECT COALESCE("u".displayname, NULLIF(BTRIM("h".userdisplayname), '')) AS "editor", COUNT(*) AS "edit_comments", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "position" FROM "posthistory" AS "h" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p" ON "p".id = "h".postid LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "h".userid WHERE "p".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "h".posthistorytypeid IN (4, 5, 6) AND NULLIF(BTRIM("h".comment), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "h".userid, COALESCE("u".displayname, NULLIF(BTRIM("h".userdisplayname), ''))) AS "counts" WHERE position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM (SELECT segment, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "total" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM (SELECT segment, increase_percentage, MAX(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "highest", MIN(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "lowest" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, 100 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301 THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301 THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 GROUP BY "c".segment) AS "increases") AS "extremes" WHERE increase_percentage = highest OR increase_percentage = lowest ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC, segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301 THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301 THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" WHERE "y".customerid IN (SELECT "t".customerid FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" WHERE "t".date = DATE '2012-08-25' AND "t".price = 634.8::REAL) AND "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201401 GROUP BY "y".customerid LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) >= 201201 AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) < 201401 AND "y".consumption <> 0 GROUP BY "c".customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) / 100) = 2) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND date < DATE '2013-01-01' GROUP BY customerid HAVING SUM(amount * price) < 30000) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".customerid = "c".customerid GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) < 201401 AND "y".consumption > 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

SELECT FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX("t".date + "t".time::TIME) - MIN("t".date + "t".time::TIME))) / 60) AS "whole_minutes" FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "gasstations" AS "g" ON "g".gasstationid = "t".gasstationid WHERE "g".country = 'CZE' AND "t".price > 1000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".currency, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT customerid FROM "yearmonth" WHERE CAST(date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST(date AS INTEGER) < 201312 AND consumption <> 0 GROUP BY customerid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT date) = 11) AS "active" ON "active".customerid = "c".customerid GROUP BY "c".currency LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(quarterly_consumption) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "eur_average", ROUND(AVG(quarterly_consumption) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK')::NUMERIC, 2) AS "czk_average" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid, "c".currency, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "quarterly_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201304 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201307 GROUP BY "c".customerid, "c".currency) AS "quarterly" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN month >= 201301 AND month < 201401 THEN total_consumption END) - MAX(CASE WHEN month >= 201201 AND month < 201301 THEN total_consumption END))::NUMERIC) AS "consumption_difference" FROM (SELECT date::INTEGER AS "month", SUM(consumption::NUMERIC) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND date::INTEGER < 201401 GROUP BY date::INTEGER) AS "monthly_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_monthly_fuel_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 15621 AND date::INTEGER >= 201301 AND date::INTEGER < 201401 AND consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((AVG(annual_consumption) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK') - AVG(annual_consumption) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR'))::NUMERIC) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid, "c".currency, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "annual_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date::INTEGER >= 201201 AND "y".date::INTEGER < 201301 AND "c".currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR') GROUP BY "c".customerid, "c".currency) AS "annual_customer_consumption" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "y".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("y".date AS INTEGER) < 201401 GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".customerid) FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "t".customerid INNER JOIN "products" AS "p" ON "p".productid = "t".productid WHERE "c".segment = 'SME' AND "t".date >= DATE '2013-02-01' AND "t".date < DATE '2013-03-01' AND "t".amount > 0 AND "p".description IN ('Natural', 'Natural +', 'Natural Plus', 'Natural Spec', 'Nat.Super') LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS "away_wins" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_api_id, "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX("w".away_wins) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "away_wins" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "m2".league_id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "w") LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN "team_attributes" AS "ta" ON "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id WHERE "ta".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "ta".date < '2013-01-01' AND "ta".buildupplaypassing > (SELECT AVG("ta2".buildupplaypassing) FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta2" WHERE "ta2".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "ta2".date < '2013-01-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, AVG("pa".heading_accuracy) AS "mean_heading_accuracy" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "pa".heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_api_id, "p".player_name ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, "p".player_api_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM "player") OR "p".height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM "player") GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name HAVING COUNT("a".finishing) > 0 ORDER BY AVG("a".finishing) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG("pa".ball_control) FILTER (WHERE "p".player_name = 'Abdou Diallo') - AVG("pa".ball_control) FILTER (WHERE "p".player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS "mean_ball_control_difference" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye') AND "pa".ball_control IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN "a".overall_rating END)::NUMERIC - MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN "a".overall_rating END)) * 100 / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN "a".overall_rating END), 0), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel') AND "a".id = (SELECT "a2".id FROM "player_attributes" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id ORDER BY "a2".date DESC NULLS LAST, "a2".id DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "pa".date FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND "pa".crossing IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "pa".crossing DESC, "pa".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".player_api_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "pa".overall_rating > 70 WHERE "p".height < 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT home_player_3 FROM "match") AS "m" ON "m".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".rated_high) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".player_api_id, BOOL_OR("pa".defensive_work_rate = 'high') AS "rated_high" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".birthday::DATE >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "pa".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') GROUP BY "p".player_api_id) AS "r" LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_short_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".team_api_id) AS "number_of_clubs", ROUND(AVG("a".chancecreationpassing), 1) AS "average_chance_creation_passing_risk" FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id FROM "team_attributes" WHERE chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky') AS "r" ON "r".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT team_api_id, chancecreationpassing, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "team_attributes" WHERE date < '2014-09-20') AS "a" ON "a".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "a".rn = 1 GROUP BY "t".team_short_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "t".team_api_id) > 1 ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC NULLS LAST, "t".team_short_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "a".rn = 1 WHERE "p".birthday >= '1990-01-01' AND "p".birthday < '1996-01-01' AND "a".defensive_work_rate = 'medium' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".weight), 1) AS "average_weight" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id FROM "player_attributes" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left') AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND "p".weight > 170 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ta".buildupplaydribblingclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id WHERE "t".team_short_name = 'POR' AND "c".name = 'England' AND "ta".date >= '2015-09-10' AND "ta".date < '2015-09-11' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name AS "club_name", "t".team_short_name AS "short_name", COUNT(*) AS "home_wins" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 3 AND (SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" WHERE "ta".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id AND "ta".date <= "m".date ORDER BY "ta".date DESC, "ta".id DESC LIMIT 1) = 'Fast' GROUP BY "t".id, "t".team_long_name, "t".team_short_name ORDER BY home_wins DESC, "t".team_long_name ASC, "t".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "number_of_players" FROM "match" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 5 GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name AS "country_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "qualifying_players" FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".country_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".weight >= 210 AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) = (SELECT MAX("country_count".player_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p2".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".weight >= 210 AND "p2".player_api_id IN ("m2".home_player_1, "m2".home_player_2, "m2".home_player_3, "m2".home_player_4, "m2".home_player_5, "m2".home_player_6, "m2".home_player_7, "m2".home_player_8, "m2".home_player_9, "m2".home_player_10, "m2".home_player_11, "m2".away_player_1, "m2".away_player_2, "m2".away_player_3, "m2".away_player_4, "m2".away_player_5, "m2".away_player_6, "m2".away_player_7, "m2".away_player_8, "m2".away_player_9, "m2".away_player_10, "m2".away_player_11) GROUP BY "m2".country_id) AS "country_count") ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "player_count", ROUND(AVG("p".height::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ma".season, "p2".player_api_id FROM "match" AS "ma" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "ma".league_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "l".country_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".player_api_id IN ("ma".home_player_1, "ma".home_player_2, "ma".home_player_3, "ma".home_player_4, "ma".home_player_5, "ma".home_player_6, "ma".home_player_7, "ma".home_player_8, "ma".home_player_9, "ma".home_player_10, "ma".home_player_11, "ma".away_player_1, "ma".away_player_2, "ma".away_player_3, "ma".away_player_4, "ma".away_player_5, "ma".away_player_6, "ma".away_player_7, "ma".away_player_8, "ma".away_player_9, "ma".away_player_10, "ma".away_player_11) WHERE "c".name = 'Italy' AND "ma".season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')) AS "m" ON "m".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, volleys, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes") AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "a".rn = 1 WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "a".volleys > 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("t".total_goals, 0)), 2) AS "average_total_home_goals" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT home_player_3, SUM(home_team_goal) AS "total_goals" FROM "match" GROUP BY home_player_3) AS "t" ON "t".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date::TIMESTAMP < TIMESTAMP '2015-01-02 00:00:00') AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "pa".rn = 1 WHERE "pa".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "pa".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".attacking_work_rate = 'low') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "a" WHERE "a".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "a".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND "p".birthday >= '1991-01-01' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name ORDER BY "p".player_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE jumping >= 80 AND date >= '2007-02-22' AND date < '2007-08-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON ("m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id) INNER JOIN "team_attributes" AS "ta" ON "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "ta".date::TIMESTAMP <= "m".date::TIMESTAMP WHERE "t".team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND "m".season = '2012/2013' ORDER BY "m".date::TIMESTAMP DESC, "ta".date::TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN "a".overall_rating END) - AVG("a".overall_rating)) / NULLIF(AVG("a".overall_rating), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, overall_rating, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date::TIMESTAMP < TIMESTAMP '2013-07-13' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "a".player_api_id WHERE "a".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') AND "a".overall_rating IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM "district") AS "salary_difference" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "dt" ON "dt".district_id = "c".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dt".a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district") AND "c".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c2".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "district" AS "dt2" ON "dt2".district_id = "c2".district_id WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' AND "dt2".a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district")) LIMIT 501

SELECT "district".a2 AS "district" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "client".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".district_id = (SELECT "d".district_id FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ("t2".balance::NUMERIC - "t1".balance) * 100 / NULLIF("t1".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t1" ON "t1".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t1".date = DATE '1993-03-22' INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t2" ON "t2".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t2".date = DATE '1998-12-27' WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a13::NUMERIC - "d".a12::NUMERIC) / NULLIF("d".a12::NUMERIC, 0)) * 100, 2) AS "percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL AND "l".status = 'D' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "district" ON "district".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type <> 'OWNER' AND "district".a11 > 8000 AND "district".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "d".type LIMIT 501

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M') AS "owners" ON "owners".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 GROUP BY "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol HAVING SUM("o".amount) = 3539 LIMIT 501

SELECT district, population FROM (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" WHERE "a".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account")) AS "opened" ON "opened".district_id = "d".district_id) AS "ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 5) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_approved_amount" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + "l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3 HAVING SUM("l".amount) = (SELECT MAX(region_total) FROM (SELECT SUM("l2".amount) AS "region_total" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id WHERE "l2".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l2".date + "l2".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "p".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "account_disp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "card" ON "card".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id) AS "card_accounts" ON "card_accounts".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "card_accounts".account_id IS NULL) AS "eligible_districts" ON "eligible_districts".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "account_loans" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "cohort" ON "cohort".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id AS "account_number", "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "l".total_borrowed, COALESCE("t".counterparties, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0 GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".gender, "ranked".district_count, "ranked".district, "ranked".inhabitants, "ranked".average_salary, "ranked".average_urban_ratio FROM (SELECT "q".gender, "q".district, "q".inhabitants, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".salary) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender), 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("q".urban_ratio::NUMERIC) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender), 2) AS "average_urban_ratio", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender ORDER BY "q".inhabitants DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "cd".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "od".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "cd".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000 AND (SELECT AVG("t".balance) FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id) > 1000) AS "q") AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".population_rank = 1 ORDER BY "ranked".gender ASC, "ranked".district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".bank AS "recipient_bank_code", "t".account AS "recipient_counter_account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000) AS "eligible" ON "eligible".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 ILIKE 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".region, ROUND(AVG("q".salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("q".unemployment::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate", MAX(CASE WHEN "q".district_rank = 1 THEN "q".district_name END) AS "most_populous_district" FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "unemployment", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, "d".a2 ASC) AS "district_rank" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "p".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "p".type = 'OWNER') AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".district_id = "d".district_id) AS "q" GROUP BY "q".region ORDER BY "q".region ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".a2 AS "district_name", "t".a15 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND((SELECT AVG("s".a15) FROM (SELECT a15 FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER(a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 3) AS "s"), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG(a15) FROM "district"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG("s".a15) FROM (SELECT a15 FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER(a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 3) AS "s") - (SELECT AVG(a15) FROM "district"), 2) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT a2, a4, a15 FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER(a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 3) AS "t" ORDER BY CAST("t".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("t".a2), 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýž', 'acdeeinorstuuyz') ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT card_type, district, inhabitants FROM (SELECT "ca".type AS "card_type", "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "ca".type ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) ASC) AS "population_rank" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "ca".disp_id = "di".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "di".client_id = "cl".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "cl".district_id = "d".district_id) AS "ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 ORDER BY card_type ASC, district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened_1996", ROUND(AVG("b".balance), 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(SUM(SUM("b".balance)) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT("b".balance)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (ORDER BY AVG("b".balance) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC) AS "highest_average_district" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "b" ON TRUE WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", ROUND(AVG("d".a11) OVER (), 2) AS "average_yearly_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", ROUND(SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / "d".a4::BIGINT, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount)::NUMERIC / "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "district_rank", ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM("o".amount::NUMERIC), 0) FROM "account" AS "ao" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "ao".account_id WHERE "ao".district_id = "d".district_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "account" AS "ac" WHERE "ac".district_id = "d".district_id), 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4 ORDER BY district_rank ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "account_opened", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", COALESCE("rc".client_count, 0) AS "region_client_count", "d".most_populous_district, "d".most_populous_population, "d".population_rank FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "di".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a11, FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE(CAST(a4 AS BIGINT)) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_population", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district") AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "hd".a3, COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "hc" INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "hc".district_id GROUP BY "hd".a3) AS "rc" ON "rc".a3 = "d".a3 WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT year AS "opening_year", SUM(account_count) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent / account_count), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "year", "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("l".amount_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY'), "a".district_id) AS "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) AS "age_at_card_issue", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("l".total_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "di".a2 AS "district_name", "di".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "di" ON "di".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "d".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-10-15' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823) AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".client_id, ROUND("l".amount::NUMERIC, 2) AS "loan_amount", "l".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("l".payments::NUMERIC * "l".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND("l".payments::NUMERIC * "l".duration - "l".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "l".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "l".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > "l".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "r".loan_count AS "regional_loan_count", "s".average_salary AS "regional_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "r" ON "r".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) AS "s" ON "s".region = "d".a3 WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "l".amount >= (SELECT MIN("top_loans".amount) FROM (SELECT "l3".amount FROM "loan" AS "l3" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp3" ON "dp3".account_id = "l3".account_id AND "dp3".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c3" ON "c3".client_id = "dp3".client_id WHERE "c3".gender = 'F' ORDER BY "l3".amount DESC LIMIT 3) AS "top_loans") ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC, "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", SUM("q".account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".duration > 24 GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("q".account_count), 0) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) AS "q" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".total_received, 0) AS "total_received", COALESCE("t".total_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_withdrawn", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("t".counterparty_count, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".counterparty_count, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold') AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_received", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT (bank, account)) FILTER (WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date)) AS "owner_age", COALESCE("cards".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN "loans".loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan' WHEN "loans".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "loans".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("t".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS "balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "di".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "di".account_id) AS "cards" ON "cards".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "loans" ON "loans".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY balance_rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "owners".client_id) AS "client_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0), 0) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "dp".client_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'classic') AS "owners" ON "owners".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "owners".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C') AS "cohort" ON "cohort".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS "cohort", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date < DATE '1920-01-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END = 'young' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 853 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END) - MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 854 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END)) * 100 / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN "r".raceid = 854 THEN "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC END), 0), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' AND "r".raceid IN (853, 854) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "res".position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "r".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, MAX("ds".points) AS "highest_recorded_driver_standings_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid AND "r".position = 1 LEFT JOIN "driverstandings" AS "ds" ON "ds".driverid = "d".driverid GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds) / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid AND "last_finisher".laps = "winner".laps AND "last_finisher".milliseconds IS NOT NULL WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND "last_finisher".positionorder = (SELECT MAX("res".positionorder) FROM "results" AS "res" WHERE "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".laps = "winner".laps AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "entry".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "entry" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "entry".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "entry".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "entry".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds::NUMERIC) / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("cr".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "constructorresults" AS "cr" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cr".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "cr".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "r".year = 2008 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY "q".q3::INTERVAL ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name AS "circuit_name", TO_CHAR(MIN("l".milliseconds) * INTERVAL '1 millisecond', 'MI:SS.MS') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' AND "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name ORDER BY "c".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("race_stop_counts".pit_stops)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "races" AS "old_race" WHERE "old_race".year = 2000 AND "old_race".name = "r".name) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_stop_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT(NULLIF(BTRIM("q".q3), '')) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1::INTERVAL = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 1995 AND "r2".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q1), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 = (SELECT "q2".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q1), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SPLIT_PART("q2".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q1) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "other".driverid) AS "drivers_outqualified" FROM "qualifying" AS "lucas" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lucas".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "lucas".raceid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "other" ON "other".raceid = "lucas".raceid AND "other".position > "lucas".position WHERE "d".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "r".year = 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q2) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(*) AS "runners_up" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY runners_up DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR(CAST("r".time AS TIME) + INTERVAL '4 hours' + "res".milliseconds * INTERVAL '1 millisecond', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "local_finish_time", "d".url FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q3) = '') LIMIT 501
