SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q2), '') IS NOT NULL AND (CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC)) = (SELECT MIN("t".q2_seconds) FROM (SELECT CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2".q2, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2".q2, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) AS "q2_seconds" FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q2), '') IS NOT NULL) AS "t" WHERE "t".q2_seconds > (SELECT MIN(CAST(SPLIT_PART("q3".q2, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q3".q2, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q3" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r3" ON "r3".raceid = "q3".raceid WHERE "r3".year = 2017 AND "r3".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q3".q2), '') IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 100 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration AS "pit_stop_length" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("q3_counts".q3_count), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM (SELECT "d".driverid, COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '')) AS "q3_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid) AS "q3_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_1_times" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared" ON "shared".forename = "d".forename WHERE "d".code IS NULL AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1::INTERVAL > INTERVAL '2 minutes' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, SUM("r".points) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT driverid, raceid FROM "laptimes") AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "r".driverid AND "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, ("f".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || TO_CHAR(("f".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000, 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR("f".fastest_ms % 1000, 'FM000') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid HAVING MIN(milliseconds) > 90000) AS "f" ON "f".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "f".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND CAST("q".q3 AS INTERVAL) = (SELECT MIN(CAST("q2".q3 AS INTERVAL)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "r".rank = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".name, "ranked".career_points, "ranked".url AS "introduction_website" FROM (SELECT "c".name, COALESCE(SUM("season_standings".points), 0) AS "career_points", "c".url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("season_standings".points), 0) DESC) AS "points_rank" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".date DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_order" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid) AS "season_standings" ON "season_standings".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "season_standings".season_order = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url) AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".points_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "ranked".points_rank ASC, "ranked".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "winning_drivers" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE "d".forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "r".rank = 1 GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".raceid) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "first_win".name AS "first_win_race", "first_win".date AS "first_win_date", "starts".races_started FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "w".driverid, "r".name, "r".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "w".driverid ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC) AS "win_number" FROM "results" AS "w" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "w".raceid WHERE "w".position = 1 AND "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) AS "first_win" ON "first_win".driverid = "d".driverid AND "first_win".win_number = 1 INNER JOIN (SELECT "s".driverid, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".raceid) AS "races_started" FROM "results" AS "s" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "s".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "st" ON "st".statusid = "s".statusid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND "st".status NOT IN ('Did not start', 'Did not qualify', 'Did not prequalify', 'Withdrawn', 'Excluded', '107% Rule') GROUP BY "s".driverid) AS "starts" ON "starts".driverid = "d".driverid ORDER BY "d".dob ASC, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q2), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q2), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND CAST('00:' || TRIM("q".q3) AS INTERVAL) = (SELECT MIN(CAST('00:' || TRIM("q2".q3) AS INTERVAL)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 WHERE "r".raceid = (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 1 INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "c".circuitref = 'monza' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) < 98 LIMIT 501

SELECT "earliest".circuitref AS "earliest_circuit_reference", "latest".circuitref AS "latest_circuit_reference", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("latest".start_time - "earliest".start_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL)) AS "earliest" CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX(time::TIME) FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL)) AS "latest" ORDER BY "earliest".circuitref ASC, "latest".circuitref ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX("r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY CASE WHEN "q".q1 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q1) = '' THEN NULL ELSE SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC END DESC NULLS LAST, "q".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "drivers_withdrew" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1962 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$' THEN "res".driverid END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1957 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "e".expense_date::DATE) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / SUM("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("r".ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "r") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT "soccer".attendees AS "womens_soccer_attendance", "fall".average_attendance, CASE WHEN "soccer".attendees > "fall".average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN "soccer".attendees < "fall".average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "soccer" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_counts".attendees), 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_counts") AS "fall" LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".department AS "department_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "me".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "ma".major_id END) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(COUNT("me".member_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "me" ON "me".link_to_major = "ma".major_id WHERE "ma".department IN (SELECT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "ma".department ORDER BY "ma".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("a".attendee_count), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".budgeted_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "budgeted_amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department')) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".department = "d".department AND "m".college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department') LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mem" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id AND "mem".position = 'Member' AND "mem".member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM "attendance") LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mem".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' GROUP BY "d".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%' AND "e".type = 'Game') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "mj".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "mj" WHERE "mj".college IN (SELECT "tyler_major".college FROM "member" AS "tyler" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tyler_major" ON "tyler".link_to_major = "tyler_major".major_id WHERE "tyler".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tyler".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "major" AS "same_major" INNER JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "same_major".major_id WHERE "same_major".college = "mj".college AND "same_major".major_name = "mj".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".member_count), 2) AS "average_members" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' AND "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma".major_id, "ma".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "ma2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma2".major_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "ma".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" WHERE "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN event_count END), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR position IS NULL THEN event_count END), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "e".event_id) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(item))) AS "count" FROM (SELECT split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ','), ',', 1) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event UNION ALL SELECT split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ','), ',', 2) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event UNION ALL SELECT split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ','), ',', 3) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event) AS "items" WHERE TRIM(item) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "departments".department IS NOT NULL) AS "members_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "departments".department IS NULL) AS "members_not_in_college" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "departments" ON "mj".department = "departments".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "cb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0) AS "chips" ON "chips".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING MAX("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb2".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "cb2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x2".cost > 0) AS "chips2" ON "chips2".link_to_event = "b2".link_to_event) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' GROUP BY "e".expense_date ORDER BY "e".expense_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type AS "event_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(college_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "college_count" FROM "member" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "ma2".major_id GROUP BY "ma2".college) AS "counts") ORDER BY "ma".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "qualifying_budget" ON "qualifying_budget".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "qualifying_budget".amount > 40 INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("b".total_spent, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(spent) AS "total_spent" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget", SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending" FROM "budget" AS "b" GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "totals" ON "totals".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM(1 + LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', ''))) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "counts" ON "counts".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("totals".total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE("totals".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("counts".purchases, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_members" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX("t".member_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e2".type) AS "t") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT item_name, budget_category, SUM(cost::DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "total_cost_usd" FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(CASE WHEN "e".expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Donuts' ELSE SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 1) END)) AS "item_name", "b".category AS "budget_category", "e".cost FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 2))) AS "item_name", "b".category AS "budget_category", "e".cost FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 2) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 3))) AS "item_name", "b".category AS "budget_category", "e".cost FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 3) <> '') AS "items" GROUP BY item_name, budget_category ORDER BY budget_category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budget, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".member_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budget" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT item_name, COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM (SELECT TRIM(split_part(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', 1)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(split_part(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', 2)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' AND split_part("e".expense_description, ',', 2) <> '' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(split_part(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', 3)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' AND split_part("e".expense_description, ',', 3) <> '') AS "items" GROUP BY item_name ORDER BY item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT full_name, kind_count, total_spending FROM (SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM("s".item))) AS "kind_count", SUM("s".cost) AS "total_spending", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM("s".item))) DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_member, split_part(expense_description, ',', 1) AS "item", cost FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, split_part(expense_description, ',', 2) AS "item", 0 AS "cost" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' UNION ALL SELECT link_to_member, split_part(expense_description, ',', 3) AS "item", 0 AS "cost" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01') AS "s" ON "s".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE TRIM("s".item) <> '' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name) AS "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_name) AS "number_of_different_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id WHERE "ma".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "s2".publisher_id WHERE "p2".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') AND "p2".publisher_name <> "p".publisher_name) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "c".colour, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "h".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "sk".id = "s".skin_colour_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "c".colour = "h".colour AND "c".colour = "sk".colour AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("m".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "m" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "m".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "m".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "m".height_cm <> 0 AND "m".id IN (SELECT "mhp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "mhp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dhp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dhp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "d" ON "d".id = "dhp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "d".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_powers" ON "dc_powers".power_id = "mhp".power_id WHERE "dc_powers".power_id IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hs".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hs" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "s" ON "s".id = "hs".power_id WHERE "s".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength_heroes" ON "strength_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id) > 0 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id)) AS "powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') OR "a".alignment IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) = (SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s2".id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "s2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp2" ON "hp2".hero_id = "s2".id WHERE "p2".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s2".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s2".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s2".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "hp2".power_id) AS "counts") ORDER BY "sp".power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_measured_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "target_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "target_ha" ON "target_ha".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "target_a" ON "target_a".id = "target_ha".attribute_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "target_a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id AND "s".hair_colour_id IN (SELECT "c".id FROM "colour" AS "c" WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) >= 10 WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Male' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hulk_attribute".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_attribute" ON "hulk_attribute".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hulk_attribute_type" ON "hulk_attribute_type".id = "hulk_attribute".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hulk_attribute_type".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm <> 0) AS "ranked_heroes" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ranked_heroes".id WHERE "ranked_heroes".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE ("s".race_id IS NULL OR "r".race IS NULL OR "r".race = '-') AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("power_counts".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "h".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "h".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "h".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "h".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "h".id) AS "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolios".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo" ON "cryo".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "holder" ON "holder".hero_id = "cryo".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "holder".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolios" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "dc".weight_kg <> 0 AND "dc".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".race_id IN (SELECT "a".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "other" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "other".gender_id WHERE "other".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND NULLIF(TRIM("p".publisher_name), '') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "b" ON "h".publisher_id = "b".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id <> "h".publisher_id WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "r".race IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "r2".race IS NOT NULL AND "r2".race <> '-' AND "s2".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r2".id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "powered" ON "powered".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id)) FILTER (WHERE "g".gender = 'Male'), 2) AS "male_average", ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id)) FILTER (WHERE "g".gender = 'Female'), 2) AS "female_average" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '[[:alpha:]]+[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]]+' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "h".id WHERE "h".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "h".height_cm <> 0 AND "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".power_name = 'Flight') AS "f" ON "f".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "lightest_heroes" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eyes".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(CASE WHEN "hair".colour <> 'Brown' THEN 1 END) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eyes" ON "eyes".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eyes".colour HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "hair".colour = 'Brown' THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eyes".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "h".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "h".weight_kg <> 0 AND "h".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE pt >= 14) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory") AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE CASE WHEN "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l2".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp <> 'negative' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".id, "t"."anti-RNP titer" FROM (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) END) AS "anti-RNP titer", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) END) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) END) IS NOT NULL) AS "t" WHERE "t".ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CASE WHEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 5 THEN 1 END END) > 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".dna AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND CASE WHEN "r".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("r".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had normal platelet result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "never had normal platelet result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~ '^[[:space:]]*([^,]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*)*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*([^,]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*)*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*([^,]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*)*RA)([[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*[^,]+[[:space:]]+susp)*[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('256') THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IS NOT NULL THEN "p".id END), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 64 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."symptoms" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "e"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e"."thrombosis" > 0 AND "e"."symptoms" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e"."symptoms" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e"."symptoms" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_examination - "First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date", MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_out_of_range", COUNT(*) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre >= 1.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".admission, "l".id, "l"."T-CHO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN "p".id END) AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN "p".id END) AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".id HAVING MAX("l".date) > DATE '1997-01-01' AND MAX(CASE WHEN "l".sc170 IS NOT NULL THEN "l".date END) IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".sc170 IS NOT NULL AND "l".sc170 NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2".sc170 IS NOT NULL)) = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "s" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "s".id WHERE "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "u"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".dna ~ '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligibility_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ldh < 500 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR TRIM("p".sex) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".id, "t".sex, "t".highest_anti_rnp_level FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp <> 'negative' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10) AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "t" WHERE "t".highest_anti_rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp <> 'negative' THEN CAST("l2".rnp AS BIGINT) END) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10) AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 4 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 ELSE FALSE END AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p"."birthday")) AS "age", "p"."diagnosis" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' AND "l"."dna" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."dna" ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' ORDER BY CAST("l"."dna" AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l"."date" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([[:space:]]*[(][^)]*[)])?([[:space:]]*,|[[:space:]]*$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC >= 4 ELSE FALSE END) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p"."admission" = '-' AND (SELECT "l"."igg" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."id" = "p"."id" AND "l"."igg" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."date" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l"."date" DESC LIMIT 1) >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".dna AS NUMERIC)) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "latest".igg > 900 AND "latest".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC, igg DESC) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-') GROUP BY CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, rnp, cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rn = 1 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 64 ELSE FALSE END AND "l".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ldh_lab" ON "ldh_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "ldh_lab".ldh >= 500 AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("e".symptoms) <> '' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission IN ('+', '+(') AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY AGE("First Date", birthday) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_anticardiolipin_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis = 'SLE' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "male_patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SJS([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SJS[[:space:]]+susp' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501
