SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm" ON "sm".id = "e".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "protein"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') AND "e".id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM "examination" WHERE id IS NOT NULL AND (thrombosis <> 0 OR thrombosis IS NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "a".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".date >= "p".birthday AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('1', '2', '3', '4', '30', '100', '300', '%%', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '-15', '>=1000', '>=300', 'TR') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_occurrences" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c1" ON "c1".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c1".atom_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c2" ON "c2".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c2".atom_id WHERE "a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n' LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')) AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE("b".has_other_bond, 0) = 0 THEN 'Every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'All other molecules' END AS "molecule_group", SUM(CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, MAX(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "has_other_bond" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "b" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE("b".has_other_bond, 0) = 0 THEN 'Every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'All other molecules' END ORDER BY molecule_group DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".element, ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "all_atoms" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "all_atoms".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+' AND "all_atoms".element = "ranked".element) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "all_atoms" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "all_atoms".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "a".element, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "element_rank" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT atom_id FROM "connected") AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element) AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".element_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 'single' WHEN '=' THEN 'double' WHEN '#' THEN 'triple' END AS "bond_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "neighbor".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "sulfur" ON "sulfur".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "sulfur".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "neighbor" ON "neighbor".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "sulfur".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".element = "a".element GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "unusual" ON "unusual".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0) AS "qualifying_molecules" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN "m".molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN "m".molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "rare" ON "rare".element = "a".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "a".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank_position", "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "a".atom_count, COALESCE("b".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "a".carbon_count, "a".chlorine_count, COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("b".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carbon_count", SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "chlorine_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "bo".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "bo".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "ca".element = 'c' OR "ca2".element = 'c' THEN "bo".bond_id END) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "bo".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN "bo".bond_id END) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "bo" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "bo".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "ca" ON "ca".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "ca2" ON "ca2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "bo".molecule_id) AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id ORDER BY rank_position ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "h".element = 'h' AND "y".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("saturated".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "u".atom_id FROM (SELECT "c".atom_id, "b".bond_type FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id", "b".bond_type FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id) AS "u" GROUP BY "u".atom_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "u".bond_type = '-' THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "u".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0) AS "saturated" ON "saturated".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "triple_atom".element FROM "atom" AS "triple_atom" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "triple_atom".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AS "triple_elements" ON "triple_elements".element = "a".element GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
